## Context / Problem

Only two subprocess-heavy interface regressions are duplicated: `test_blame_autoderives_single_culprit` and `test_ambiguous_blame_draws_no_autolink` at `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_caused_by_autoderive.py:66-118` and `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_caused_by_autoderive_heldout.py:58-117`. This is hardening work, not a production-defect fix: keeping both copies increases CI time and makes later contract changes require parallel edits.

The held-out module is not wholesale duplicate code. It must retain `test_library_facade_threads_caused_by` at lines 45-55, which covers the Python facade’s `caused_by` forwarding, and `test_user_guide_has_blame_hunt_advisory` at lines 120-130. The canonical module likewise retains its separate CLI explicit-`--caused-by` test at lines 37-57.

## Approach

Keep the canonical two auto-derivation regressions as the sole coverage of their single-culprit and ambiguous-blame behaviors. Delete only their held-out copies. Retain the two held-out boundary tests and the canonical explicit-flag test unchanged. Then remove only imports and private helpers made unreachable by deleting the duplicated held-out tests; do not parameterize across the facade, CLI-explicit, or documentation boundaries.

## Scope

- `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_caused_by_autoderive.py` — canonical duplicate coverage remains unchanged
- `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_caused_by_autoderive_heldout.py` — remove only the two duplicate test bodies and any now-unreachable test helpers/imports

## Testing

Collect and run both modules before and after the change. Verify one collected instance each of the single-culprit and ambiguous-blame test names, plus the retained facade, explicit-flag, and user-guide-advisory tests. Run the focused interface suite.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `test_blame_autoderives_single_culprit` and `test_ambiguous_blame_draws_no_autolink` remain in the canonical module and are removed only from the held-out module.
- [ ] The held-out module retains `test_library_facade_threads_caused_by` and `test_user_guide_has_blame_hunt_advisory`; the canonical module retains `test_explicit_caused_by_on_bug_close`.
- [ ] Any held-out imports or private helpers that become unreachable after those two removals are deleted, with no remaining test referencing them.
- [ ] Focused collection reports exactly one instance of each auto-derivation regression and reports all three distinct boundary tests.
- [ ] Both lifecycle test modules and the focused interface suite pass.
